subject.facility_name: HARBOR VILLAGE NORTH HEALTH AND REHABILITATION CEN

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $138.91 per resident day (43.7% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -2.8% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $36,370, 0.6% of the $6,011,549 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $946,336, $21.87 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $479,606 (50.7%), allocated fringe $75,082 (7.9%), non-wage costs $391,648 (41.4%). Raw food was $353,122 ($8.16 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $606.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $286,790, $6.63 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $286,790 (100.0%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $179,801, $4.15 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $179,801 (100.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2016, 2017, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
